WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    AlbumId,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS FLOAT) / Milliseconds) as rate,
    COUNT(*) as track_count
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
mean_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) as mean_album_rate
  FROM album_rates
),
above_mean AS (
  SELECT 
    ar.rate,
    ar.track_count,
    ar.rate - mr.mean_album_rate as excess
  FROM album_rates ar, mean_rate mr
  WHERE ar.rate > mr.mean_album_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(rate) as avg_rate,
  AVG(track_count) as avg_track_count,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_mean
